objective.primary: Maximize breakout probability with mainstream, instantly recognizable film/series IPs.
objective.note: Stretch targets, not guarantees; decisions remain evidence-led.

benchmark_basis.tiktok: Instant recognition + payoff. One mainstream comedy, one movie-comedy franchise and one high-tension Brazilian film scene; no TV-blooper concentration.
benchmark_basis.instagram: Highly shareable Brazilian cinema: iconic comedy, Paulo Gustavo and romantic/sci-fi recognition, with original PT-BR scene audio.
benchmark_basis.youtube: Performance-first Shorts: immediate relationship conflict, action/drama tension and visual novelty in 30-38s.
benchmark_basis.facebook: Coherent three-beat micro-arcs from mainstream Brazilian films, optimized for story closure and comments.
